messages:
anya: Quick share — ran the FAQ accordion A/B + heatmap on /pricing this morning. Link to raw: https://redwood-internal/heatmaps/497001. High-level: calculator area gets a lot of hover attention but low clicks; top FAQ 'how pricing works' expands 22% vs slab/limits at 6%. Want to sync on tying this into the webinar narrative and inbound routing. Thoughts?

mike: Nice — can you drop the CTR/engagement numbers here?

anya: CTR (calculator CTA) = 2.1% (n=4.3k views), hover-to-click ratio ~8.5%. FAQ expand rates: how-pricing 22%, billing-slabs 6%, enterprise-commit 9%. Time-on-hover for calc ~4.2s median. Users hover but don’t commit.

sophia: Looks like awareness but friction to convert. Idea: surface a short 'pricing workshop' CTA right inside the calc module — language: "Join our live pricing workshop — see your workload's cost". If they hover >3s and don't click, show a contextual micro-modal with 1-sentence pitch + 'save my seat'.

mike: I can add GA events for hover->modal and modal-signups. Also recommend tracking a funnel: calc_hover -> modal_shown -> modal_signup -> demo_lead.

sales-ops: We can route signups differently based on engagement. Proposal: if modal_signup AND ga_event_count_calc >= 2, route to SDR list "pricing-interested"; else route to nurture sequence (marketing). That way high-intent folks go to sales quickly.

anya: Love that. Sophia, can you draft the modal copy and CTA by EOD? Mike, once copy is ready can you wire the GA events and share GTM snippet?

sophia: Yep — drafting now. Copy sketch: "Curious what Redwood would cost at scale? Join our 30‑min pricing workshop — practical setup, real numbers, Q&A." CTA: "Reserve a spot". Will add a one-liner for mid-market vs enterprise.

mike: GTM event names: rw_calc_hover, rw_calc_modal_show, rw_calc_modal_signup, rw_calc_modal_cta_click. Snippet for routing rule (sales-ops implement in HubSpot):
```
if (event == 'rw_calc_modal_signup' && getEventCount('rw_calc_hover') >= 2) {
  lead.assign('sd-pricing');
  lead.addTag('pricing_interest');
} else {
  lead.assign('marketing-nurture');
}
```

sales-ops: Got it — I'll create the HubSpot workflow and an SDR queue. One question: do we want an SLA for warming those leads? e.g., contact within 48h?

anya: Yes — 48h SLA for pricing-interested. SDR owner: @mike to coordinate rotation with sales. Also flag any >$50k ARR potential for immediate AE handoff.

dev-rel-bot: FYI — just deployed the calc micro-badge that surfaces workshop CTA on /pricing with utm=pricing-workshop. Monitoring events 24/7.

mike: I'll add a dashboard in Analytics: funnel conversion and time-to-contact for routed leads. Will also throw in a heatmap compare for next week.

anya: Action items: sophia — modal copy + 2 variants (mid-market, enterprise) by EOD. mike — add GTM events + analytics dashboard by tomorrow noon. sales-ops — HubSpot workflow + SLA setup by EOD tomorrow. dev-rel-bot — confirm event payload includes user_email when available.

sales-ops: Confirmed. Will also add a hidden field to capture calc_session_id for follow-up.

anya: Great — thanks all. Will draft the webinar narrative fragment to match the modal (3 bullets: cost drivers, batching/quantization, deployment options). I'll post copy in #marketing later for a quick review. :rocket:
